blurb: Belle Chasse Marine Transportation operates the largest launch service on the Lower Mississippi River, offering crew boats, supply vessels, barges, and push-boats. They provide dependable marine transportation services from Pilot Town to Baton Rouge with U.S. Coast Guard-certified crews. Their fleet includes vessels ranging from 15 to 33 feet and barges with cranes and oil capacity.
